policies.description: Block any route that leaves the active workspace namespace.
Shared client artifacts require explicit write permission and supervised approval.
policies.reason: Shared artifact write requires supervised approval

policies.description: External system writes are never unattended.
Stop when canonical sources are stale or missing.
Number changes must preserve old -> new lineage and stop for review.
Coordinator must reapply model and runtime config on every resume and rotation.
Subagents may extract or review but cannot schedule or recurse.
Prefer proven existing components over net-new builds only after provenance, license, PwC approval, privacy, security, client-isolation, accessibility, and runtime-dependency checks pass.
policies.reason: Third-party reuse requires documented compliance and security review
